result:
I’d make empathy unavoidable: every person would clearly feel, in a moment of choice, the real impact of their actions on others.

Not mind-reading, not forced kindness—just the inability to comfortably ignore the suffering or dignity of other people when your decisions affect them. Most harm, I think, survives because distance, abstraction, and self-interest make other people’s pain easy to overlook. If that distance vanished, a lot of cruelty, corruption, and indifference would become much harder to sustain.
